speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are an 8-year-old having trouble sleeping and waking up frightened. To help you, can you tell me if these episodes happen every night or only sometimes?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Night Terrors (Sleep Terrors).

I have noted that the episodes occur 1-2 times weekly over two months, involve yelling and crying, and that the child is consolable the next day without confusion, which distinguishes this from nightmares. Do you have any concerns about her safety during these episodes, or has she ever been injured while screaming?
